title: Factorization of Finite Cyclic Group $\Bbb Z_{(pqr)^2}$: Szabó Pairs and Full Tiling Structures
summary: In the study of factorizations of finite cyclic groups, a classical problem is to investigate the properties of factorization sets $A$ and $B$ in the direct sum decomposition $A \oplus B = \mathbb{Z}_{M}$ with $|A| = |B| =\sqrt{M}$, where $M=(pqr)^2$ for some distinct primes $p$, $q$, and $r$. In this paper, we show that neither $A$ nor $B$ is contained in a proper subgroup of $\mathbb{Z}_{(pqr)^2}$ if and only if the factorization sets $A, B$ form a Szabó pair.
